summary: Empery Digital Inc. filed an 8-K reporting an amendment (No. 2) and waiver to its existing At-The-Market Issuance Sales Agreement with Aegis Capital Corp. The amendment extends the agreement's term to automatically terminate upon issuance and sale of all authorized shares, waiving a prior termination provision. No price, premium, or transaction value is disclosed; the filing solely modifies an equity distribution program. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
